events.body:
Parent work item: blt-api#1

Mirrored from historical GitHub issue: https://github.com/OWASP-BLT/BLT-API/issues/96

## Problem
BLT-Jobs needs a canonical backend API path under BLT-API v2.

## Route Direction
- `GET /v2/jobs`
- `GET /v2/jobs/{id}`
- `POST /v2/jobs`
- `PATCH /v2/jobs/{id}`
- `POST /v2/jobs/{id}/view`
- `GET /v2/organizations/{id}/jobs/stats`

## Acceptance
- [ ] Add a `jobs` migration and seed data.
- [ ] Add list/detail/create/update/view/stats routes.
- [ ] Public list shows only public active non-expired jobs.
- [ ] Create/update requires organization permission.
- [ ] Add focused tests and route metadata.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-api/-/issues/6 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-05-29).

**Discussion summary**

- Partly done: `/v2/jobs` list, create, update, `/view` and `/stats` exist, scoped to the creating user.
- @Preetam-77 asked the review bot for a plan. It proposed extending, not replacing, the current handler: migration 0016 adding `organization_id` and `visibility`, legacy rows staying public, then organization permission checks and tests.
